name: star-burxt component
//: A `.sbmx` is a BMX document with star's sections cut out of it. So this grammar does exactly what the generator does: recognise the sections, hand each to the language that owns it, and hand everything else to BMX.
//2: `===bx` gets `source.burxt`, `===style.*` gets `source.css`, and the rest gets `text.bmx` — which then picks up star's injection above. Nothing is reimplemented; three existing grammars are pointed at three regions.

section-style.//: `local` and `global` are coloured the same, deliberately: neither is the default, so neither should look like one.
section-style.name: meta.embedded.block.css

section-unknown.//: A section star does not know. Marked INVALID rather than left to look like markup, because the generator refuses it and a reader should see that before they run anything.
